props.question: What happens when an AI draft is close but not quite right, and who decides what changes before it reaches customers?
props.answer:
An editor reads the draft against the brief and marks what is missing, off-tone, or unsupported. Small fixes happen on the spot. Larger ones go back to your agents as structured notes, so the next pass starts from a decision rather than a guess.

What we look for on every draft:

  • Does it say one thing a reader can repeat?
  • Is every claim something your team can stand behind?
  • Does it sound like you, not like a model?

Your team keeps the final call on what ships.
